# Fetch Terminal

> A free, open source (GPL-3.0-or-later) terminal emulator for Linux, built with
> Electron by Lightmorphic. Made for people who don't want to memorize
> commands: saved snippets run with a click, previously-typed commands
> autocomplete as a ghost suggestion, and an encrypted password vault
> types passwords without ever showing them.

Key facts:

- Ships as a single AppImage; needs no FUSE library, so it runs on
  current Ubuntu, Fedora, openSUSE, Mint, Arch and immutable spins.
- Passwords are encrypted with the OS keyring and are write-only: once
  saved they can only be used or deleted, never viewed or exported.
  The vault is PIN-gated; five wrong guesses lock it for an hour.
- No analytics, telemetry, or tracking. The app's only self-initiated
  network request is a release check.
- Multi-line pastes reach the shell as one bracketed block: nothing
  runs until Enter is pressed, and password prompts still work.
- Light/dark/auto themes with 15 full-strength accent colors.
